content.title: 50 Free Promotional Housing Units
summary: A 50-home R+13 residential development in Sidi Benour, part of a wider 362-home free promotional housing programme.
The Sidi Benour project is a vertical housing development designed to meet the demand for quality homes while improving access, utility networks, and external site organisation.
description: The project combines TCE and VRD delivery for an R+13 residential building, coordinating the structure, facades, technical systems, and external circulation.
Vertical lines, projecting balconies, and considered facade treatments define the building's identity, while utility networks and access works ensure the residence is operational.
content.authority: A high-rise residential development where the structure, facade rhythm, VRD, and technical systems meet the demands of dense urban housing.
